name: Wake word
description: The classic way: AAC answers when one of its names is said (or right after it spoke). Optional: a quick check that someone is really talking to it, and a look back at what was said just before the name.

follow_up.title: Follow-up without the name (seconds)
follow_up.help: Right after AAC spoke, the next sentence needs no name (0 = always say the name).

attention.title: Check that someone is really talking to AAC
attention.help: A quick model call with the last few lines: a video or TV saying the name is ignored.

look_back.title: Look back (seconds)
look_back.help: What was said this many seconds before the name goes with the request ("…, remind me of that, computer"). 0 = only the sentence with the name.
